rho_reference.strongest_available_basis: All six curves are prime-order curves over prime fields (p and r prime, r = p + 1 - t, validator check on the ICV1 strings) with j not 0 or 1728 (j read from ICV1 and reproduced from a, b solved from G and the targets), so Aut(E) = {+-1}: negation is the only automorphism fold and no Frobenius fold exists; records show automorphisms_used 2.
rho_reference.gae_band_row: icv1-fp24-tm1297-6f714a52: ic = dg (candidate, N_inc) mean S over its 144 measured runs, rho = rho-neg mean S over the same 144 (target, round) pairs; every row in gae_band_by_row; the srenew baseline in gae_band_baseline_by_row
rho_reference.order_note: rho-neg < dg and rho-neg < srenew at w = 0, 0.1 and 1 on every row (order_holds_across_band for the baseline: True). dg against srenew in counted units is NOT ordered across the band: dg charges +1 GAE on the pairs where a repeated target decomposes, so Sum S_dg > Sum S_srenew at w = 0 on every curve and dg < srenew at w = 0.1 and 1; the improvement this file admits is the wall-clock one (ns per charged GAE), not a counted ranking.

caveats: 24 and 32 bits: pass. Wall-clock improvement of dg over srenew at N_inc, corrected dg/srenew ns per GAE 0.9128 [0.9099, 0.9157] at 24 bits and 0.8486 [0.8451, 0.8521] at 32 bits, as a component speed-up outside tables A-C. 28 bits: pass with caveats, 0.8862 [0.8837, 0.8887], but E6 condition 2 fails, so srenew stays the 28-bit baseline.

Not a counted improvement: dg charges +1 GAE per late-caught repeated target (about 7% of pairs), so dg/srenew is about 1.000002 at w = 0 and below 1 at w = 0.1 and 1. The two are not ordered across the band in counted units.
ns per GAE is an upper bound per operation for both arms, on EKS c8a.2xlarge only. The wall time is not replayable; the counted scalars are, with 7,776 of 7,776 runs identical on another host.
Two fresh curves per size, 24 targets x 6 rounds. The per-curve ratios differ beyond their intervals at 24 and 32 bits.

dg always ran at the middle position of the alternate order. The within-run null (oracle_setup wall ratio within 0.2% of 1) and the probe dose-response bound any position effect far below the measured gain.
